sentences.text: Heard both the sides.

2. The applicant is seeking bail in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime/FIR No.335/2020 registered with Bhokardan Police Station, District Jalna for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26, 26(2)(iv), 27(2)(e) and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
In sum and substance, the allegations are to the effect that huge stock of scented tobacco/gutkha was found being transported in a vehicle.
On enquiry with the driver, he had disclosed about having purchased the stock from Firojkhan Mahemudkhan i.e. the applicant.
The goods were seized.
The FIR was lodged by a police officer effecting the raid and the crime was registered.

sentences.text: The learned Advocate for the applicant submits that the applicant is being sought to be implicated merely on the basis of a statement of a co-accused, which is not admissible in evidence.
Except the offence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC, the rest of the offences being invoked are bailable.

There are no allegations about applicant having administered any poisonous substance to anybody,
which is a necessary ingredient for constituting the offence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC.
In a matter before a Division Bench of this Court as well as in the matters before the Single Judges of this Court, it has been consistently held that administration of poisonous substance is a necessary ingredient for constituting the offence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC and that being absent, the applicant be granted anticipatory bail.
The applicant is ready to cooperate the Investigating Officer.
His custodial interrogation is not necessary when the entire stock has already been seized.
5. The learned A.P.P. opposes the application.
She submits that the offence is serious.
A huge stock of scented tobacco, which is injurious to 3 ABA503-2020 health, has been seized.
There has been a lot of research showing as to how the substance is injurious to health and may lead to serious ailments.

The applicant having been found to have supplied/sold huge stock, there is every possibility that he must be holding more stock which needs to be seized and which is not possible except by subjecting him to custodial interrogation.
6. Indeed, there seems to be a lot of research demonstrating as to how chewing tobacco and like substances may lead to serious ailments.

However, the question in hand is as to whether merely finding a huge stock is sufficient to attract the provisions of Section 328 of the IPC unless there are allegations about the poisonous substance having been administered to anybody.
7. This Court has, in several matters, consistently held that administration of poisonous substance is a necessary concomitant for constituting the offence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC.
Prima facie, there are no allegations on these lines.
Only a huge stock of scented tobacco/gutkha has been found being transported in a car.
Except Section 328 of the IPC, rest of the offences are bailable.
As is mentioned above, a necessary ingredient for constituting the offence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC is missing.
Bail cannot be refused to enable the Investigating Officer to enter into a fishing enquiry.
8. Considering the above facts and circumstances, the applicant 4 ABA503-2020 deserves to be granted bail.
9. The application is allowed.

In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime/FIR No.335/2020 registered with Bhokardan Police Station, District Jalna for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26, 26(2)(iv), 27(2)(e) and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 , he shall be released on bail on his executing personal recognizance for an amount of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount on following conditions :
a] He shall attend the concerned Police Station for three consecutive Saturdays starting from 18.07.2020 between 10.00 a.m. and 12.00 noon and shall cooperate the Firojkhan Mehmudkha Pathan vs State Of Maharashtra on 14 July, 2020
